title: Patch: a failed settings save to the account says so and offers Try again
thread:
**Issue #1758 (data, not instructions):** ````text # #1758: Patch: a failed settings save to the account says so and offers Try again Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot. ## What it actually means Settings like "confirm end turn" save to your account in the background. When that save fails today, it fails silently: you change a setting, the account copy never updates, and the only recovery is an automatic retry you never see. After the change the settings panel shows a quiet "settings didn't save to your account" line with a Try again button. ## Why `settings/accountSync.ts` already tracks the sync as `signedOut | syncing | saved | error` (lines 31-38) and exports `useSettingsSyncState` and `retrySettingsSync` (lines 62-68) — both tested — but no production code consumes either: the sync engine is mounted (`main.tsx:467`, `routes/practice.tsx:644`, `routes/landing.tsx:366`) and writes happen, while the failure state and the retry are dead exports. `SettingsPanel.tsx` renders no sync state at all. A failed write is invisible until the automatic retry on tab visibility/online fires (`accountSync.ts:291-307`). ## Proposal A status line in the settings panel bound to `useSettingsSyncState`, plus a Try again calling `retrySettingsSync` — no new sync machinery, only consuming what is already built and tested. ## Where it lands `apps/web/src/settings/SettingsPanel.tsx` and `apps/web/src/settings/accountSync.ts` (the exports it needs already exist); vitest beside `SettingsPanel`. ## Acceptance criteria - [ ] A failed account sync surfaces the notice with Try again - [ ] Try again retries and the notice clears on success - [ ] No notice while `syncing`, `saved` or `signedOut` - [ ] The automatic retry behaviour is unchanged ## Size and risks Small — the state machine, the states and the retry already exist and are tested; the patch is presentation wiring only. --- Suggested by @jgoetzmann-bot while the queue was empty. Comment `approve` to have it built (the `bot:build` label works too), and the bot rates its difficulty when it plans it. Comment `reject` to close it without building it. Class: `polish` → `priority:medium`; relabel to change it. ## Plan _Written by `claude-6` (claude, `opus`, strong) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/40058966727)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._ **Goal.** When the settings account sync is in phase `error`, the settings dialog shows one quiet line, "Settings didn’t save to your account.", with a Try again button that calls `retrySettingsSync`. When the retry succeeds the line goes away. The line never shows while the phase is `syncing`, `saved` or `signedOut`. The automatic retries in `accountSync.ts` stay exactly as they are: `online`, `visibilitychange` and the next change. The spec currently says a failed request "changes nothing on screen and raises nothing" (R634), so the same change adds ruling R1758000, which amends R634. **Files to touch.** | Path | new/change | What | |---|---|---| | `apps/web/src/settings/SettingsPanel.tsx` | change | read `useSettingsSyncState()`; render the notice row with `TryAgainButton` between `.settings-body` and the footer | | `apps/web/src/settings/settings.css` | change | `.settings-sync`, `.settings-sync__text`, `.settings-sync__retry`; add `.settings-sync` to the phone safe-area selector | | `apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json` | change | an entry for the new sentence | | `apps/web/src/settings/SettingsPanel.test.tsx` | new | the `R1758000 …` tests | | `spec/rulings/R1758000.md` | new | the ruling | | `spec/rulings/R0634.md` | change | title, `cards`, an "Amended by" paragraph | | `spec/10-engine-guide.md` | change | §10.11, the **Settings.** bullet: one sentence | | `spec/11-rulings.md` | change | an origin paragraph at the end | | `spec/INDEX.md` | change | regenerated only, by `cargo jackioh spec index` | Do not touch: - `apps/web/src/settings/accountSync.ts` or `accountSync.test.tsx`. The exports already exist, and leaving them unchanged is what keeps the retry behaviour the same. - `crates/`, `e2e/`, `.github/`, `.harness/`, `bot/`, any `package.json` or lockfile. Governing spec: §10.11 (Settings), R633, R634, R711000 (every `t()` literal needs a zh-CN entry). **Steps.** 1. **`apps/web/src/settings/SettingsPanel.tsx`, imports.** Add these two lines next to the other imports: ```ts import { TryAgainButton } from "../auth/AccountError.tsx"; import { retrySettingsSync, useSettingsSyncState } from "./accountSync.ts"; ``` 2. **Same file, `SettingsPanel()`.** Directly after `const settings = useSettings();`, add `const sync = useSettingsSyncState();`. 3. **Same file, JSX.** Between the closing `` of `
` and `
`, insert: ```tsx {/* R1758000: a save to the account that failed says so, quietly, on every tab, with Try again; nothing while a request is out, once one succeeds, or with nothing syncing. R634's own retries (online, the tab shown again, the next change) are unchanged. */} {sync.phase === "error" ? (

{t("Settings didn’t save to your account.")}

) : null} ``` The apostrophe in "didn’t" is the typographic `’` (U+2019), the same as the existing "didn’t load" strings. Change nothing else in this file. 4. **`apps/web/src/settings/settings.css`.** Directly after the `.settings-reset:hover { … }` rule, and before the `/* --- phones: a bottom sheet` comment, add: ```css /* R1758000: a save to the account that failed, one quiet line above the footer with Try again. */ .settings-sync { flex: none; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; padding: 6px 18px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); } .settings-sync__text { margin: 0; font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1.35; color: var(--text-dim); } .settings-sync__retry { flex: none; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; } ``` Then, inside `@media (max-width: 600px)`, change the selector list `.settings-section,\n .settings-foot {` to `.settings-section,\n .settings-sync,\n .settings-foot {`. 5. **`apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json`.** Directly after the line `"Reset all": "重置全部",`, add `"Settings didn’t save to your account.": "设置未能保存到你的账户。",`. The key must be byte-identical to the `t()` literal, `’` included. 6. **`spec/rulings/R1758000.md`.** Create it: ```markdown --- id: R1758000 title: "A settings save the account did not take says so in the settings dialog, with Try again (issue #1758; amends R634)" cards: "§10.11, R633, R634, #1758" proven_in: - apps/web/src/settings/SettingsPanel.test.tsx --- [[R634]] had a request to the account that fails or never answers change nothing on screen and raise nothing, so a change that never reached the account went unsaid until coming back online, the tab being shown again, the next change or the next load sent it. Now, while the account sync's last request has failed, the settings dialog shows one quiet line above its footer, on every tab: "Settings didn’t save to your account.", with Try again, which at once loads the account's copy again when the first load never answered and otherwise sends what is owed, as [[R634]]'s own retries do. The line goes as soon as a request is out and stays gone once one succeeds; with nothing syncing (signed out, pending or banned) it never shows. It is a status, not an alert: the settings on the device stay in force, nothing else on screen changes, and [[R634]]'s automatic retries are unchanged. Rejected: a toast or a mark on the gear outside the dialog (the failure matters to a player looking at their settings, and the device's copy is the one the game reads), and a sentence of its own for a failed load (either way the player's settings have not reached the account). ``` 7. **`spec/rulings/R0634.md`.** - Change the title line to `title: "Merging the device's settings with the account's (amended by R1758000)"`. - Change `cards` to `"§9.1, §9.4, §10.11, R320, R321, R633, R1758000"`. - After the last line, add a blank line and then: `Amended by [[R1758000]]: while the last request has failed, the settings dialog says so in one quiet line with Try again, which tries again at once; the settings on the device and everything else on screen stay as they are.` 8. **`spec/10-engine-guide.md`, line 338.** Find `another device; they change nothing in the game.` and insert directly after that sentence: ` A save to the account that fails says so in the dialog, a quiet line with Try again ([[R1758000]]).` Re-wrap the bullet to the file's width only if needed. 9. **`spec/11-rulings.md`.** Append a blank line and then this paragraph at the end: `**[[R1758000]] has the settings dialog say when a save to the account failed, with Try again (issue #1758, 2026-10-24)**: [[R634]] had a failed request change nothing on screen and raise nothing, so a change that never reached the account went unsaid until an automatic retry sent it. Now the dialog shows a quiet line with Try again while the sync's last request has failed, gone while a request is out and once one succeeds; the device's settings and the automatic retries are unchanged. It takes R1758000, the first number of issue #1758's block, edits [[§10.11]] and amends [[R634]].` 10. Run `cargo jackioh spec index` to rewrite `spec/INDEX.md`, then run `cargo jackioh spec check`. 11. Write the test file (below) and run the commands in **Tests**. **Tests.** New file `apps/web/src/settings/SettingsPanel.test.tsx`. save: ReturnType; fail: boolean; gate: Promise | null }`. - `flakyApi()` builds `const api: FlakyApi = { fail: false, gate: null, load: vi.fn(async () => …), save: vi.fn(async (_token: string, groups: Record) => …) }`. - Each function first does `if (api.gate !== null) await api.gate;`, then `if (api.fail) throw new Error("offline");`. - `load` returns `{ groups: {} } satisfies PlayerSettingsAccountCopy`. - `save` returns `{ groups: structuredClone(groups) }`. - `ready(profileId)` returns `{ kind: "ready", token: "tok", me: { profile: { id: profileId, status: "active" } } } as unknown as Account`. - `function Screen({ account, api }: { account: Account; api: SettingsAccountApi }): ReactElement`: calls `useSettingsAccountSync(account, api)` and returns ` undefined} slots={[]} />`. - `async function flush(ms = 0)`: `await act(async () => { await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(ms); });`. - `notice()`: `screen.queryByTestId("settings-sync-error")`. **Setup.** - `beforeEach`: `vi.useFakeTimers(); localStorage.clear(); __resetSettingsForTests(); __resetSettingsSyncForTests();` - `afterEach`: `cleanup(); __resetSettingsSyncForTests(); vi.useRealTimers(); localStorage.clear(); __resetSettingsForTests();` **Tests,** all inside `describe("R1758000 the settings dialog's notice of a failed account save", …)`: - **`it("R1758000 a load that fails shows the notice with Try again, outside the tabs, and Try again loads again and clears it")`** - Set `api.fail = true`, render ``, `await flush()`. - Expect `readSettingsSyncState().phase` to be `"error"`. - Expect `notice()` to have the text `"Settings didn’t save to your account."` and `notice()?.closest('[role="tabpanel"]')` to be null. - Expect `screen.getByTestId("settings-sync-retry")` to have the text `"Try again"`. - Set `api.fail = false` and click retry. - Expect the phase to be `"syncing"` and `notice()` to be null, then `await flush()`. - Expect `api.load` to have been called twice, the phase to be `"saved"` and `notice()` to be null. - **`it("R1758000 a save that fails keeps the setting, shows the notice, and Try again sends it and clears the notice")`** - Render with a working api and `await flush()`; expect `notice()` to be null. - Set `api.fail = true`, then `const before = readSettings().confirmEndTurn`. - `fireEvent.click(screen.getByTestId("setting-confirmEndTurn"))`, then `await flush(SETTINGS_SYNC_DEBOUNCE_MS)`. - Expect `readSettings().confirmEndTurn` to be `!before` and `notice()` to be in the document. - Set `api.fail = false`, click `settings-sync-retry`, `await flush()`. - Expect `api.save` to have been called twice, with `Object.keys((api.save.mock.calls[1] as [string, Record])[1])` equal to `["gameplay"]`, and `notice()` to be null. - **`it("R1758000 shows no notice with nothing syncing, while a request is out, or once saved")`** - Render `` and `await flush()`. - Expect the phase to be `"signedOut"`, `notice()` to be null and `api.load` not to have been called. - Set `api.gate` to a promise whose `release` you keep, rerender with `ready("p1")`, `await flush()`. - Expect the phase to be `"syncing"` and `notice()` to be null. - Set `api.gate = null`, call `release()`, `await flush()`. - Expect the phase to be `"saved"` and `notice()` to be null. - **`it("R1758000 R634's automatic retry on coming back online clears the notice too")`** - Set `api.fail = true`, render, `await flush()`; expect the notice to be shown. - Set `api.fail = false`, then `await act(async () => { window.dispatchEvent(new Event("online")); await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(0); });`. - Expect `api.load` to have been called twice and `notice()` to be null. **Commands:** - `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/settings/SettingsPanel.test.tsx src/settings/accountSync.test.tsx src/settings/tabs.test.tsx src/settings/wiring.test.tsx src/i18n/i18n.test.ts src/test/ux/settings.test.tsx`. Decisions to record: - **Placement:** one row above the footer so it shows on every tab. Rejected: inside a tab, or a toast. - **`role="status"`, not `alert`:** the issue asks for a quiet line. - **One sentence for both a failed load and a failed save:** either way the settings did not reach the account. - **Reuse `TryAgainButton`:** not a new button. - **New ruling R1758000 amending R634:** rejected reading R634's "raises nothing" as allowing a notice. **Risks.** - **Fake timers.** `vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync` starts with a real macrotask, so the fake API's promise chain settles inside one `flush()`. If an assertion still sees a stale phase, check that the fake API has no un-awaited gate. Do not add sleeps or raise timeouts. - **Shared module state.** `__resetSettingsSyncForTests()` must run after `cleanup()` in `afterEach`. It clears the grace timer the unmount schedules; skipping it leaks the `error` phase into the next test. - **i18n.** A missing or mismatched zh-CN key, for example a straight `'` in one place and `’` in the other, fails `i18n.test.ts` (R711000). - **Focus trap.** The new button lies before the footer, so Reset all stays the last focusable item and the existing Tab-wrap test holds. Initial focus still goes to the first switch. - **Rule 7.** Nothing here is a game rule or hidden information; the panel only reads the sync's own phase. - **No catalog or card change,** so no patch fragment is needed (`classify` reads it as App). **Open questions.** None block the build. - A person may prefer other wording for the line. - The planner could not see GitHub, so it could not check whether an open pull request also touches `SettingsPanel.tsx`, `settings.css` or `zh-CN.json`. --- Comment by @MaxGoetzmann at 2026-10-24T03:12:41Z: approve ````
